metadata.title: Lyapunov spectrum, Harder--Narasimhan filtration and thin monodromy
metadata.abstract: We study the equality case of the inequalities between the Lyapunov spectrum and the Harder--Narasimhan slopes of a semi-simple local system with non-expanding cusp monodromy over a finite-area hyperbolic surface. This gives a nonlattice-transversality alternative of the monodromy group. On the other hand, we generalize Filip's Assumptions A and B to give classes of polarized variation of Hodge structures that achieve the equality. As an application, we recover the thinness of C-32 in $\mathrm{Sp}_6\mathbb{R}$. Besides, we provide an upper bound, called average Cartan spectrum, that dominates the Lyapunov spectrum and study its rigidity.
metadata.comment: 65 pages,including a declaration of AI use, comments are very welcome

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 研究有限面积双曲曲面上、具有非扩张尖点单值性的半单局部系统，分析 Lyapunov 谱与 Harder–Narasimhan 斜率不等式的等号情形，并给出单值群的非晶格性与横截性的二择关系。作者推广 Filip 的假设 A、B，以得到若干达到等号的极化 Hodge 结构变分，并作为应用恢复 C-32 在 Sp(6,R) 中的薄群性质。此外定义称为平均 Cartan 谱的上界，证明其支配 Lyapunov 谱并研究刚性。
techniques: Lyapunov 谱与 Harder–Narasimhan 斜率比较
半单局部系统及非扩张尖点单值性
极化 Hodge 结构变分的等号条件
平均 Cartan 谱及刚性
analysis.breakthrough: 把谱比较中的等号与单值群几何、Hodge 条件相联系，并提出支配 Lyapunov 谱的平均 Cartan 上界。
analysis.limitations: 需保留半单性、有限面积和非扩张尖点条件。摘要未列二择关系、推广假设及刚性结论的精确形式，不能将其解释成任意局部系统的统一薄性判别。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.priorityReason: 与双曲曲面上的谱、Hodge 几何及刚性直接相关，优先核对等号条件与平均 Cartan 界。
